sheets.prompt:
Create a photographic contact sheet at landscape aspect ratio 3:2, ideally 1536 x 1024 pixels, consisting of exactly THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 12 distinct horizontal 2:1 photographs in strict row-major order. No padding, borders, titles, numbering, writing, overlays or collage inside any cell. Each cell is a single credible documentary photograph of an adult employee in the Netherlands, everyday authentic workplace, natural daylight, realistic hands and materials, no school or classroom, no charts, no rulers, no readable price labels, numbers or screens. Full-frame compositions with the required material very clearly visible. These are atmosphere and work-conversation photos, not pictures from which to count or measure. Each scene must look like a genuinely different location and moment from a stock image of the same work, using a fresh camera position and credible action. Treat the following 12 cell instructions independently.
Cell 1 (row 1, column 1): packing orders at a retail dispatch station. the real work task in progress, no clocks, no visible timers, no calendar. close oblique overhead view. The activity involves winkelartikelen. Essential material: winkelartikelen.
Cell 2 (row 1, column 2): A shop employee clips a plain plastic front strip onto the edge of a small display shelf. Shelf fixings and hands clearly visible, nearby everyday retail goods. The strip contains no writing or digits. Essential material: een presentatiestrook.
Cell 3 (row 1, column 3): An adult Dutch shop assistant restocks unbranded chilled dairy products in an open refrigerated display. Clear view of the employee and cold shelves, no visible thermometer or numerical labels. Essential material: producten in de koeling.
Cell 4 (row 2, column 1): An adult household shop assistant helps a customer pay with euro cash at a modest Dutch shop checkout. Hands, actual euro money and checkout counter clearly visible; screen off or unreadable. Ordinary shop goods. Essential material: Afrekenen bij de winkelkassa.
Cell 5 (row 2, column 2): folded kitchen towels at a housewares checkout. a natural close-up at the payment counter, items clearly visible, a generic payment terminal with its screen turned away, no banknotes or coins. wide close-up showing hands and the working surface. The activity involves keukendoeken. Essential material: keukendoeken.
